speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
text: asked	the Minister for Education (Schools) how many applications from international students for our local schools have been rejected in 2017 and whether the Ministry will consider increasing the percentage of international students in local schools to above 5% to better accommodate the education needs of children of resident workers who actively contribute to our economy.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: While MOE continues to make available places in our mainstream schools for international students, we will not be able to meet the demand entirely.
